_comment: Edit this, then re-upload it WITHOUT recompiling:
Six rows show at once -- that is what fits at text size 2, and size 1 is
already known to be too small to read on this panel. A longer list pages
through six at a time every 8 seconds. 32 symbols maximum.
Labels are capped at 5 characters, which is the width of the symbol box.
stocks: Yahoo symbols, one HTTPS request EACH, swept one per loop pass so
the button and clock stay alive during a refresh. Measured: 22
requests 0.3s apart drew zero 429s, so breadth is cheap here; a
22-stock sweep takes about 30s and then idles until the next
coins:  CoinGecko ids (the id, not the ticker) -- all of them travel in a

_brightness_comment: Backlight duty, 8-255. This is the ONE dial that measurably moves power on
this board: measured steady-state die temperature is 45.1C at 140, 43.5 at
100, 40.5 at 60 and 37.1 at 0 -- so the panel is worth about 8C and the SoC
alone floors at 37C. Duty is proportional to LED current, so lowering it
saves real power even where the die sensor barely moves.
Defaults sit well under the 140 the shared themes use, because a black
screen with high-contrast text stays readable much dimmer than a light UI.
Push 'open' down to 60 if it is still too bright; that is another ~3C.
